The '''''Skyjumper''''' was a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] [[Captain/Legends|captained]] by [[Drev Jalok]] and crewed by [[Sullub Soonin]]. The ship was attacked by the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Drek Drednar]] while on route to the [[Altier system/Legends|Altier system]].
